_instructions: Edit the text values below directly on GitHub (pencil icon on this file → edit → commit). Don't touch the field names (the part before each colon), only the text after it. The foyer screens re-fetch this file once a day (2am) plus on every full reload, so a change here reaches both foyer TVs within a day without touching the TVs themselves. Keep this a valid JSON file — if GitHub shows a red warning when you commit, something's broken (usually a missing comma or a stray quote mark) and the screens will fall back to the last-known-good content instead of using your edit.
